# EasyTech

> EasyTech provides friendly, local tech support in Coquitlam, Burnaby, Surrey, and Vancouver, BC. Services include Wi-Fi & network setup, phone/tablet setup, smart home devices, home office setup, senior-friendly tech guidance, small business IT assistance, device optimization & security, and website development. Flat rates range from $40–$120 per service, with 20% off the first visit.

- [Pricing](https://easytechvancouver.ca/#pricing): Flat-rate pricing from $40–$120 per service, with bundle discounts and 20% off first visits.
- [Tech Tips & Local Guides](https://easytechvancouver.ca/#blog): Local guides on smart TV & sound setup, Wi-Fi troubleshooting, and smart home device setup in Metro Vancouver.
- [Contact](https://easytechvancouver.ca/#contact): Call or WhatsApp 819-434-2389 to book a service.
